integrity_notes: Two complete standalone standard-library programs were executed successfully; the recurrence certificate reconstructs every Boolean-relation state and verifies all 117 finite recurrence equations. No external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: One synchronous update on indexed binary cyclic rings only; no classification of multiple-step images, rotation quotients or preimage multiplicities. The all-length proof uses exact finite-state and Cayley–Hamilton arguments; independent historical-priority validation is still needed.
title: A Tribonacci–Lucas parity law for cyclic images of elementary cellular automata
